# WorkCover WA

> WorkCover WA is Western Australia's government agency administering the workers compensation and injury management scheme, providing claims support, dispute resolution, and regulatory oversight.

WorkCover WA operates under the Workers Compensation and Injury Management Act 2023 and serves injured workers, employers, and insurers across Western Australia. The agency provides comprehensive information on claims processes, worker entitlements, dispute resolution services, and compliance requirements.

## Key Topics

- Workers Compensation and Injury Management Act 2023
- Claims process
- Worker rights and entitlements
- Conciliation and Arbitration Services
- Dispute resolution
- Return to work
- Regulatory compliance
- Compensation payments
- Injury management
- Workplace rights
- Advice and Assistance Service
- Stakeholder engagement
- Accessibility support
- Non-English interpreter services

## For Workers

- [Workers](https://www.workcover.wa.gov.au/workers): Workers compensation information and rights for injured workers
- [Making a claim](https://www.workcover.wa.gov.au/workers/understanding-your-rights-obligations-entitlements/making-a-claim): How-to guide for lodging a workers compensation claim in WA
- [Understanding your rights, obligations and entitlements](https://www.workcover.wa.gov.au/workers/understanding-your-rights-obligations-entitlements): Guide to worker rights, obligations and compensation entitlements
- [Receiving compensation and provisional payments](https://www.workcover.wa.gov.au/workers/understanding-your-rights-obligations-entitlements/receiving-compensation): Guide to compensation entitlements and payment calculations
